root_idea.summary: The root centers on firewood or fuel, with related meanings extended by resemblance to what is gathered, carried, kindled, or made into a burden.
root_idea.development: From the concrete sense of firewood, the lexical tradition develops figurative uses for assistance, burden-bearing, mixed or harmful speech, and tale-bearing, alongside specialized references to branches and their cutting.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the normalized Classical Arabic noun citation form حَطَبٌ.

senses.definition: Firewood: wood prepared or used as fuel.
senses.usage_conditions: The basic concrete meaning of the Quranic noun; it occurs explicitly in the description of fuel for Hell.

senses.definition: Tale-bearing, calumny, or slander, figuratively conceived as carrying firewood among people.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative interpretation of حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ in 111:4, where carrying firewood is explained as spreading malicious reports or enmity.

senses.definition: Thorns carried or scattered as an obstruction.
senses.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ in 111:4, referring to thorns reportedly carried or thrown in the way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To collect firewood; with a benefactive object or لِـ, to collect or bring firewood for someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be actual firewood or a thing collected as firewood; the benefactive construction identifies the recipient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To aid or assist someone, or side with his wishes.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic figurative construction, literally describing collecting firewood in another person's rope.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bring someone wealth or property.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with بِخَيْرٍ, where خير is explained as wealth or property.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incite, urge, or instigate others against someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative construction used of provoking opposition against a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To calumniate or slander someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative verbal construction distinct from the noun's Quranic phrase-level use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut off the dry or useless portions of a grapevine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of pruning portions of the vine that are suitable only for firewood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abound in firewood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a place and, in the cited usage, also to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become lean or meagre.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or stative development distinct from the noun حَطَبٌ ‘firewood.’

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a grapevine, to reach the time when its dry portions must be cut off.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The usage may also refer to reaching the time of bearing grapes together with the required cutting of upper portions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of rain, to tear up the roots or stems of trees as though making firewood of them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use describing destructive action toward trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel, to feed on the small, dry parts of branches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The cited description associates this feeding behavior with a sound and exceptionally strong camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take upon oneself a burden or responsibility in an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom understood as binding the matter onto oneself like a bundle of firewood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The dry prunings of a grapevine.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This specialized nominal use refers to portions cut from the vine, especially annual cuttings from its upper parts, rather than firewood in general.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Very lean or meagre.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an adjective, especially of a person and apparently also of cattle.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Unlucky or unfortunate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately reported adjectival usage of the same headword.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The pruning of a grapevine down to the part in which its sap runs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized term for severe or thorough vine pruning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or land abounding in firewood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a descriptive noun or adjective of a place.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A handful or bundle of firewood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A measure or gathered quantity of firewood.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A collector of firewood; in an intensive usage, one who collects and sells it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensive sense is associated with حَطَّابٌ, while حَاطِبٌ denotes the ordinary collector.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A confused speaker or actor who mixes good and bad in speech or affairs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiom comparing such a person to one who gathers firewood by night without seeing what he collects; it may also describe harmful, unrestrained speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel that feeds on the small, dry parts of branches.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal description, distinct from the ordinary noun for a firewood collector.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pruning knife.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tool used for cutting vine portions or branches.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel that eats dry thorns.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of feeding on dry thorny vegetation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small creeping creature that moves along with pieces of wood or sticks clinging to it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized zoological description.

cautions: The expression حَمَّالَةَ الْحَطَبِ in 111:4 has more than one reported interpretation: figurative tale-bearing or calumny, and an alternative account involving carrying or scattering thorns. The contextual English rendering alone does not resolve between them.
